newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian defence minister puts off U.S. trip.
newsitem.headline: Russian defence minister puts off U.S. trip.

text.p: Russia said on Tuesday that Defence Minister Igor Rodionov, embroiled in a row with the Kremlin over the sacking of one of his top commanders, had postponed a visit to the United States this week.
A ministry spokesman told Reuters that an Interfax news agency report of the postponement, attributed to senior defence officials, was correct. The spokesman gave no reason for the postponement.

However Rodionov's decision followed a day of confusion and conflicting statements from the Kremlin and the defence ministry over the ousting of General Vladimir Semyonov, commander of Russia's ground forces since 1991.

The ministry told the press on Monday that Semyonov was being sacked for misconduct, but President Boris Yeltsin's spokesman said he was only suspended and dissociated the Kremlin from the misconduct charges.
Rodionov was due to begin a four-day visit to Washington on Wednesday in return for a visit to Moscow by U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry in October.
A foreign diplomat said it was clear Rodionov's trip had been put off until the uncertainty over Semyonov's sacking, which was unpopular with many officers, was cleared up.
